CNH | AI Engineer Intern | Tempe, AZ, USA | ON-SITE | Summer internship (40 hours/week, May–August)

Work on autonomy and precision agriculture, applying AI, machine learning, and computer vision to real-world agricultural problems. You'll help develop, evaluate, and deploy models alongside our engineering team.

Stack: C++, Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, Git.

We're looking for strong programming skills and a solid understanding of ML fundamentals. You must be a current college student actively pursuing a degree. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Apply: https://join.cnh.com/job/AI-Engineer-Intern/5686-en_US
